MEASURED 2026-08-26, from a user report that reflow2 "still speaks its own jargon and never asks who I am". The report is correct, and the cause is not a missing idea — it is a mechanism that was BUILT AND NEVER LANDED.

═══ WHAT WAS MEASURED ═══

  `lens` in the served surface (get_skill / list_skills toolsnaps)   ABSENT
  `reader_lens` / `lens_line` / `ReaderLens` in shipped code         ZERO occurrences
  the branch commit                                                  EXISTS: e01c760
                                                                     "WIP: lens on the skill response —
                                                                      core green, mcp handler tests unrun"

`cap:the-skill-response-carries-the-lens` says so itself and is honest about it: status `in_progress`, and its description records that the code sits on `lens-hint-rides-the-loop-rail`, was deliberately NOT marked `realized` at the v0.36.0 cut, and should move only "when the branch merges". **It never merged.** Six core tests passed; five MCP handler tests were written and never run.

═══ ⭐ WHY THIS IS NOT THE ORDINARY THREE-LEGS FAILURE ═══

The usual shape is a leg that was never built. Here the leg was BUILT, TESTED at the core, and left on a branch — which is worse in one specific way: **the design records the capability, so every reading of the graph says the mechanism exists.** It appears in `capabilities_covered` on the v0.41.0 release report, because that list derives from the components and artifacts a release ships rather than from a capability's STATUS. A reader of the release record would conclude the lens shipped.

═══ WHAT THE PERSONA ACTUALLY HAS TODAY ═══

  typed tool    `add_contributor` carries `description`             ✓
  instruction   TWO served skills mention asking (where-am-i,
                capture-intent) — and only those two               PARTIAL
  delivery      nothing carries it on the wire                      ✗ (the unmerged branch)
  detector      nothing notices a Contributor with no background    ✗

⇒ **A session that never invokes those two skills is never told to ask, and is never handed what the design already knows.** The design holds a background for 5 of 6 Contributors; none of it reaches an agent that did not run `where-am-i`.

⚠️ AND THE LIMIT THE CAPABILITY ITSELF NAMES REMAINS UNTOUCHED BY ANY OF THIS: the tests prove the lens computes and is attached; "they do not prove an agent acts on it, and nothing proves the translation is any good. This fixes 'the agent forgot'; it does not touch 'the agent translated badly'." Landing the branch would close the delivery gap and leave the quality question exactly where it is.
